records.title: Columbo
records.meta: TV series · NBC · USA · English · S04E06 'A Deadly State of Mind'
records.mechanism: Hypnotic suggestion with a phone trigger word, by her psychiatrist Dr. Mark Collier
records.summary: Nadia Donner's husband Carl is killed by her psychiatrist and lover Dr. Collier, who has her tell police it was a home invasion. When Columbo doubts the story, Collier hypnotises the newly widowed Nadia: on hearing a trigger word on the phone she undresses and dives from her fifth-floor balcony toward the pool, and dies. Columbo later traps Collier.
records.provenance: Widow/divorcee hypnosis sweep round 2, 14 Oct 2026 PT
records.widow_divorcee: Widow (husband murdered earlier in the episode)
records.pregnancy_note: She dies from the fall; no pregnancy in the summary.
records.kids_note: No children mentioned in the source.
records.note: Merged into the existing 1975 Columbo card to tag the widow-divorcee category; episode-level detail only.

records.title: Secrets of the Sisterhood
records.mechanism: Cult indoctrination and coercion (pledge ritual, blackmail, surveillance); no hypnosis
records.confidence_flag: Low-medium · borderline: cult manipulation rather than hypnosis
records.summary: After her mother's death and her husband Rick leaving her, Ashley Shields joins a secret women's group, The Sisterhood, led by charismatic Desiree. It wins her a raise and a favourable divorce, then pulls her into money laundering and blackmail, and Desiree goes after Ashley's inheritance. Ashley works with police, is captured, and is rescued; she ends on probation, reunited with her sister and daughter.
records.provenance: Widow/divorcee hypnosis sweep round 2, 14 Oct 2026 PT
records.kids_note: Teenage daughter Grace, from her marriage to Rick (from before); no new children.
records.note: Borderline fit: mind control here is cult coercion, not hypnosis.
